entries.53a426b54c809ee4: It develops and manufactures physiological measuring equipment such as electroencephalographs and electrocardiographs, patient monitors that continuously measure electrocardiograms, blood oxygen saturation and other data, and therapeutic equipment such as defibrillators, AEDs and ventilators.
